title: I AM: Self Sovereign zk-ID
tagline: “I AM” is the mobile web3 Self-Sovereign NFT ID that helps Latin Americans control their future—enabling access to the quality of life that is currently unavailable for them, making them visible to their countries.
description:
The Problem
1 in 7 people worldwide don't have a Federal or National ID. This means over 1.1 Billion people today don't have access to the economy, health, education, and other human rights.

Turning 14% of today's humans into invisible beings inside our society.

In Latin America, one of the causes is the lack of public infrastructure that should provide the basic identification service.

The Solution

We'll provide that infrastructure with "I AM".

"I AM" is the mobile web3 Self-Sovereign NFT ID, that helps Latin Americans get control of their future and gives their governments the tool to improve the quality of life of thousands almost instantly.

Enabling access to a life of quality, making populations visible to their countries.

How?
Nowadays, 86% of Latin Americans have smartphones. We'll turn the smartphones of Latin Americans into optional accessibility tools for Proof of Personhood, bringing a gigantic social infrastructure to the service of the people while preserving their privacy.
how_its_made:
First Use: This project uses Worldcoin for PPPoPP verification in the front, to give access to build a NFT zk ID, that will be minted into a smart contract into the Polygon, Mina, Aztec, Scroll, and Streamr Network protocols. Once minted, the users will have access to their ID on our platform.

Our host and information management will be IPFS for safety and decentralization.

Daily Use: Users can log in using WalletConnect, Metamask, ENS, and Coinbase to access the private smart contract and ID.
